title: Greenline onboarding: trial gates, procurement route, and billing start
text:
Greenline onboarding: trial gates, procurement route, and billing start

['From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick follow-up from Friday — trial next steps

Hey Stephanie,

Thanks for the deep dive on Friday. Priya (procurement) asked that I loop her in here so we can lock down the procurement path and the billing trigger for the pilot. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- For the 30-day pilot we discussed, when would Redwood expect billing to start if we exceed the agreed usage thresholds? Is start-of-billing tied strictly to the trial end date or to a usage/activation trigger?
- We need a clear list of what would qualify as a successful trial (so our clinical ops can sign off). Can you confirm the success criteria you recommended?
- Procurement: we can do card-on-file for small pilots but anything billed > $25k needs a PO. We also wanted to check whether Redwood is available in the AWS Marketplace (preferred if legal wants a faster procurement path).

Attaching a high-level trial metrics sheet we put together. Can we get a short mutual action plan and a recommended billing trigger by mid-week?

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Integrations
Greenline Health
+1 415-555-0182
', "From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick follow-up from Friday — trial next steps

Alex / Priya — thanks for the clear ask. High-level answers below and a proposed MAP attached. Short summary up top: billing start can be tied to either (A) trial end date or (B) a usage trigger (recommended) — we'll mirror whatever you need operationally; procurement route does include Marketplace but we should confirm SKU/contract path before relying on it for PO timelines.

Trial success criteria (recommended, by product):
- Integration: API integration complete with predictable <200ms median latency across a 95th percentile traffic window.
- Usage: >= 25k generated tokens over 14 consecutive days and at least 3 distinct clinical workflows using responses.
- Quality: pass a 100-case prompt set with >= 85% acceptance rate from the clinical reviewers (we can help craft the rubric).

Billing triggers (options):
1) Trial-end billing: billing starts the day after the pilot end date if you choose to convert.
2) Usage-trigger billing (recommended): billing starts once the 25k token-in-14-day threshold is crossed and mutual ops confirm readiness. This avoids double-billing for test traffic.

Procurement options:
- Card: fastest, recommended for < $25k pilots.
- PO (invoice): standard for approved budgets > $25k; typical lead time 10–15 business days after PO submission.
- AWS Marketplace: we are listed, but marketplace billing uses different contract mechanics; it can speed procurement only if your procurement team will accept the marketplace T&Cs.

Next steps I propose: 
1) You confirm which billing trigger you prefer (trial-end vs usage-trigger) by Wed 4/1.
2) Priya — if PO is likely, could you share routing (PO contact + Proc template) and an estimated approval window?
3) We’ll send a short SOW + MAP today and a Marketplace SKU reference if you want that option.

Attaching: MAP (mutual-action-plan.pdf) and our suggested success-metrics workbook.

Thanks — will keep it tight.

— Stephanie
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf (PDF, 45KB); trial-success-metrics.xlsx (Excel, 22KB)
", 'From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from Friday — trial next steps

Thanks Stephanie — useful breakdown. A couple notes from procurement: 

- PO looks likely; budget is approved but final PO issuance depends on legal review of the SOW. If Redwood can give us a short SOW (1 page) and a standard commercial invoice template, I can push this through faster.
- Marketplace: procurement will only accept AWS Marketplace if the SKU maps to the same commercial terms as the SOW — otherwise they consider it a separate purchase order. Can you include a Marketplace SKU reference in the SOW if possible?
- Billing trigger: prefer usage-trigger to avoid accidental charges during integration testing. Also, please confirm whether token counting excludes API health-check pings (we prefer those not to count).

If you can get the SOW + SKU + invoice template by EOD tomorrow, I’ll start internal routing.

Priya
Sr. Procurement Manager
Greenline Health
', 'From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@greenlinehealth.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick follow-up from Friday — trial next steps

Priya / Alex — thanks. Quick confirmations and delivery plan: 

- We’ll adopt the usage-trigger billing model. Billing will start the day the 25k tokens/14-day rolling threshold is confirmed by both sides. We will exclude automated health-check pings and backfill any accidental test traffic from the trial window on request.
- I’ve asked our legal ops to produce a one-page SOW + invoice template and include the Marketplace SKU (if available) in that SOW. Expect those files in your inbox by EOD today.
- Karthik, Marcus — looping you to note PO routing expectations and to prepare a lean SOW + invoice template (attach Marketplace SKU if available). Marcus, can you also confirm typical PO lead time and whether we can pre-authorize a short grace period if approval runs long?

Proposed next milestone: once PO or card is confirmed, we schedule a 30–45 minute ops onboarding call (integration engineer + clinical ops) the week of 4/6 to validate metrics and test the acceptance rubric.

If that all sounds good I’ll send the SOW + MAP now.

— Stephanie
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachments sent: Greenline_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, trial-success-metrics.xlsx
